sections.content: Acceptance and Quick Dev trust recovery preserves lifecycle boundaries, requires prepared hash-bound requests, derives runs through start-or-resume behavior, and rejects unbound historical evidence.
sections.title: Scope

sections.content: Migration materializes declared R0-R2 tests. Terminal validation covers R0-R4, allowlisted commands, plan state, knowledge context, receipts, artifact bindings, candidate hashes, and structured failure reporting.
sections.title: Validation

sections.content: Successor identity and lineage must be reserved before materialization, retries must resume or fail closed, freshness and source drift are gated, legacy RED reuse is exact-match only, and historical dogfood remains read-only.
